configurations.name: rerun-backend-demo
runtimeArgs: cd backend && (if exist data\rerun_demo_clean.db del /q data\rerun_demo_clean.db) && set DEMO_MODE=1&& set NEBIUS_API_KEY=&& set TAVILY_API_KEY=&& set DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./data/rerun_demo_clean.db&& .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000

configurations.name: rerun-backend-live
runtimeArgs: cd backend && (if exist data\rerun_live_ui.db del /q data\rerun_live_ui.db) && set DEMO_MODE=0&& set DAILY_COST_CEILING_USD=2.50&& set DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./data/rerun_live_ui.db&& .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000
